evals.prompt: For an authorized $implement-test --create trial, review the initial fixture request for offline mocked credential propagation. Explain the test-data and worker-assignment requirements without launching or changing the trial.
evals.expected_output: The review requires exact not-a-secret mock values in patched environments and expected-call assertions, copied into affected assignments before dispatch. Runtime credentials keep their declared handling.
assertions: The mock input and expected assertion use the same explicit not-a-secret placeholder.
Affected assignments repeat the constraint before dispatch.
Mock values never replace actual runtime credentials or change application acceptance.

evals.prompt: An authorized $implement-test --create trial stopped when a mock credential literal matched sensitive-content screening. Explain how to preserve the failed evidence and validate corrected fixture guidance without altering the active trial or weakening the guard.
evals.expected_output: Retain the original failure, use separate disposable copies to compare placeholder behavior and test outcomes, preserve credential screening, and require a fresh trial for changed initial guidance.
assertions: The unchanged guard accepts the explicit placeholder but still rejects realistic credential literals.
An isolated counterfactual preserves test assertions and does not mutate product-owned state.
The failed trial remains failed; runtime or delivery is not claimed from offline controls.

evals.prompt: During an authorized $implement-test --create trial, independent reporting replay has passed before lifecycle validate-results. Explain which owner records workflow-statistics PASS and how to handle an already conflicting immutable stage without changing the active trial. Do not launch or mutate a trial.
evals.expected_output: Retain the independent observation as evidence and leave workflow-statistics PASS to lifecycle validate-results after canonical semantic replay. Generic record-stage must reject that success before mutation. Preserve an existing conflict as failed trial evidence and qualify a fresh trial after the owner correction.
assertions: Only validate-results publishes workflow-statistics PASS after semantic replay.
Generic success recording is rejected without changing lifecycle state; prose cannot pre-satisfy acceptance.
An existing immutable conflict is not rewritten or relabeled as a passing trial.
